prompts.prompt:
Use [img1] as the sole visual authority for the architecture, courtyard, container modules, roof geometry, facade openings, materials, landscape, people, diagrams, site plan, typography, labels, colors, and final presentation-board composition.

Create a fast-paced 15-second architectural presentation reveal. Do not begin with the completed board. Start from a dark charcoal background and progressively assemble the board through point clouds, depth maps, wireframes, technical drawings, typography, diagrams, and finally the photorealistic architecture.

Preserve the architecture exactly. Do not redesign the building.

[0.0–1.5s — ARCHITECTURE EMERGES]

Start from near-black.

A faint point cloud flashes into existence in the upper portion of the frame, rapidly transforming:

point cloud → depth map → white architectural wireframe → shaded clay model.

Roof edges, container modules, balconies, windows, courtyard boundaries, and structural lines are traced in quick succession with sharp rhythmic flashes and scanning effects.

[1.5–3.2s — HERO IMAGE REVEAL]

The wireframe snaps into the photorealistic courtyard rendering.

Color and material flood into the image:
white container walls, timber roofs, glass reflections, grass, trees, and warm sunlight.

The hero image locks into its final upper-board position.

Subtle life begins immediately:
tree branches sway,
grass moves,
people make small gestures,
sunlight shifts across the facades.

[3.2–4.4s — TYPOGRAPHY]

The title appears letter-by-letter with elegant tracking expansion.

Subtitle and location follow.

Divider lines shoot into place.

Small labels reveal sequentially.

Keep all typography sharp, clean, and stable once revealed.

[4.4–6.4s — SPATIAL SEQUENCE]

The first analytical module flashes in as fragmented white linework.

Its layers rapidly assemble:
ground plane → building volumes → balconies → roofs → courtyard.

Orange arrows sweep through thresholds and semi-private zones toward the courtyard.

Labels appear one by one beneath the diagram.

[6.4–8.3s — DAYLIGHTING]

A lateral light sweep activates the second diagram.

Sun icons appear.

A curved solar path draws across the architecture.

Warm light rays move over the roofs and into the courtyard.

Reflected light and subtle airflow paths animate briefly.

The hero image above responds with changing sunlight and moving tree shadows.

[8.3–10.1s — CIRCULATION]

The third axonometric appears as a translucent technical model.

Orange circulation paths race around balconies and climb vertical connectors.

Small moving points suggest occupants traveling through the building.

The animation settles into the final circulation diagram.

[10.1–11.8s — SITE + DATA]

The lower section assembles rapidly from left to right.

Site context appears.

The site boundary traces itself.

The plan develops from thin drafting lines.

Project data appears row-by-row with precise editorial timing.

The full board is now nearly complete.

[11.8–13.5s — BUILDING COMES ALIVE]

Shift emphasis back to the large hero rendering.

A subtle push-in occurs only inside this image.

Existing people begin moving naturally.

Add several more occupants:
one person enters a ground-floor doorway,
another exits,
a student crosses the courtyard,
one person walks along an upper balcony.

Doors open and close softly.

Foliage moves more clearly.

Sunlight passes through leaves and shadows glide across the facades.

[13.5–15.0s — FINAL CLIMAX]

A final pulse travels from the hero rendering downward through the board.

Spatial sequence activates.
Daylighting activates.
Circulation activates.
Site plan activates.

Fine orange and white lines briefly connect the analytical systems, then settle.

Hold the complete final board while subtle life continues inside the hero rendering:
people walking,
people entering and leaving,
moving foliage,
soft reflections,
shifting sunlight.

[MOTION STYLE]

Fast, rhythmic architectural motion graphics.
Point-cloud reconstruction.
Depth-map transitions.
Wireframe-to-photoreal reveal.
Rapid drafting-line animation.
Masked typography.
Diagram assembly.
Circulation tracing.
Animated light paths.
Strong acceleration and clean easing.

The first 11 seconds should contain frequent visual events every 0.3–0.8 seconds.

Use the rhythm:
FLASH → DRAW → ASSEMBLE → LOCK.

Once revealed, each module remains in its final position.

[CRITICAL RULES]

Do not rotate the entire board.
Do not turn the board into a separate full-screen architectural flythrough.
Do not rearrange the layout.
Do not redesign the building.
Do not alter the container massing, roof geometry, facade rhythm, courtyard proportions, balconies, windows, or structural logic.
Do not replace the original diagrams.

Avoid neon HUDs, cyberpunk effects, random particles, excessive glow, or generic tech graphics.

Keep the visual language architectural, editorial, precise, and premium.

[AUDIO]

Deep opening impact, scanner pulses, drafting scratches, paper-like swishes, subtle mechanical clicks, soft transition whooshes.

As the hero image comes alive, introduce quiet courtyard ambience:
footsteps, distant conversation, doors opening, leaves moving in the breeze.

Finish with one clean low-frequency impact as the full board locks into place.

No dialogue.

prompts.prompt:
@ Image1 is the sole authority for the PROOF logo: the roundel of five concentric rings
and the PROOF wordmark in heavy geometric rounded sans. Reproduce the mark and the
spelling P-R-O-O-F exactly and never alter, restyle or re-letter them. @ Image2 is the
authority for the branded kraft bakery bag. @ Image3 is the authority for the courier,
the canvas bread satchel and the dawn street.

[GOAL]
A 15-second vertical 9:16 social launch commercial for PROOF, a dawn bakery delivery
service. Fast-cut, caption-led, designed to be understood with the sound off. Photoreal
documentary commercial cinematography on 35mm, fine grain, shallow depth of field,
handheld with restrained movement.

[THE LIGHT IS THE CLOCK]
The film brightens continuously from beginning to end. It opens in near-darkness lit by
a single work lamp and finishes in full warm golden sunrise. Every shot is measurably
lighter than the one before it. This progression must be unbroken.

[CAPTION CHIPS]
Throughout, a single caption chip sits in the lower third, horizontally centred, in the
same position in every shot. It is a rounded rectangle in burnt ochre with warm cream
text, two lines: a lighter-weight top line and a bold bottom line. The chip changes
content on the cuts listed below and never moves, resizes or animates. Type must be
crisp and correctly spelled.

[SEQUENCE — cut on every timing, eight cuts]
0-1.9s    HERO. Interior of a small bakery at night, lit by one overhead work lamp.
          A baker's hands turn a large mass of wet dough on a floured steel bench.
          Everything else in the room is black.
          CHIP: "04:12" / "someone is already awake"
1.9-3.6s  INSERT. Extreme close-up, a handful of flour thrown across the bench, dust
          catching the single lamp.
          CHIP unchanged.
3.6-5.4s  HERO. A row of round dough balls resting in floured proving baskets on a rack.
          Slightly warmer, slightly brighter. One dough is visibly swollen and domed.
          CHIP: "05:30" / "it's proving"
5.4-7.1s  INSERT. An oven door swings open and a wall of steam rolls out toward camera,
          lit warm from inside.
          CHIP unchanged.
7.1-8.9s  HERO. A dark-crusted round sourdough loaf lands on a cooling rack. Hold on it.
          The crust is visibly crackling and ticking as it cools.
          CHIP: "06:15" / "it's out of the oven"
8.9-10.6s INSERT. The loaf is slid into the kraft PROOF bag from @ Image2, the top folded
          over once and taped. The ochre roundel and wordmark clearly readable.
          CHIP unchanged.
10.6-12.3s HERO. The courier from @ Image3 rides away down an empty terraced street in
          low golden sunrise, satchel on their back, PROOF mark readable, streetlights
          switching off behind them.
          CHIP: "06:52" / "it's moving"
12.3-13.6s INSERT. The kraft bag set down on a stone doorstep in full golden light,
          exactly as in @ Image2. A hand withdraws from frame. Steam rises from the fold.
          CHIP: "07:04" / "it's at your door"
13.6-15s  END FRAME. Cut to a clean flat warm cream background. The PROOF concentric
          ring mark and wordmark from @ Image1 sit centred, still, in burnt ochre and
          dark rye brown. Beneath them, small, in dark rye brown: "now delivering".
          CHIP for the final beat only: "bread younger than your alarm", single bold
          line, centred. Absolutely no motion on this frame — it is a still card.

[COLOUR]
Burnt ochre is a physical object in the world before it is ever an interface colour —
it is printed ink on the kraft bag and on the canvas satchel, lit by real light. The
caption chip is the only ochre graphic element. Palette: warm cream, kraft brown, burnt
ochre, dark rye brown, one cool blue-grey in the pre-dawn shadows.

[AUDIO]
Diegetic sound only, no music of any kind. The mix should feel close, warm and real.
0-3.6s    The dead quiet of a room at 4am: an extractor fan humming, wet dough slapping
          and stretching against steel, a scraper, the soft thud of flour.
3.6-7.1s  Quieter still. A rack wheeled a short distance. The heavy clunk of an oven
          latch and a deep roll of escaping steam.
7.1-8.9s  THIS IS THE MOMENT THE WHOLE FILM IS BUILT AROUND. A loaf on a wire rack, its
          crust crackling and ticking as it cools — a fine, irregular, delicate series
          of snaps and pops, close-miked and clearly audible above everything else.
          Bring the rest of the mix down under it.
8.9-12.3s Kraft paper crumpling and folding, tape torn. Then outdoors: a freewheel
          ticking, tyres on wet tarmac, one blackbird, distant early traffic.
12.3-15s  The bag setting down on stone. Footsteps leaving. Birdsong. Then near silence
          under the end card, with one last faint crust tick.
No music, no voiceover, no narration, no dialogue, no whoosh transitions, no sound
effects that are not physically present in the scene.

[NEGATIVE]
No text of any kind other than the caption chips, the PROOF wordmark, and "now
delivering". No other logos, no brand names, no shop signage, no readable street signs,
no house numbers, no phone screens, no app interfaces, no price, no website, no social
handles, no hashtags, no watermarks. Do not alter the PROOF mark's ring count or the
spelling of the wordmark. No music. No people speaking. No faces held in close-up for
longer than one second — this is about the bread, not a character. No slow motion, no
speed ramps, no lens flare, no colour grading toward teal or blue. The caption chip
never moves position. Do not add a ninth shot. Do not animate the end card.

@[ref img] is the sole visual authority for Kaze, the football, the complete player-stats interface, typography, numbers, icons, colors, lighting, layout, and vertical composition. Animate this exact screen without redesigning it. Preserve all existing labels and final stat values.
[Goal]
Create a polished 15-second anime sports-game player stats screen opening. Use one continuous, locked, straight-on full-screen composition with no camera movement, cuts, cropping, or perspective distortion.

[Sequence]
0–2.2 seconds: Begin from near-black teal. A faint horizontal scanner passes downward, revealing Kaze’s silhouette and the outer edges of the interface. Fine particles and dim mint circuitry flicker awake.
2.2–5.5 seconds: The header, KAZE nameplate, role badge, level panel, and overall panel resolve through clean line-draw animations. Kaze emerges fully from shadow, takes a controlled breath, subtly shifts her shoulders and raised arm into the referenced pose, then fixes an intense gaze toward the viewer. Her hair, ribbons, and loose clothing react naturally to a growing current of wind. The football begins a slow, stable rotation beside her hand.

5.5–10.8 seconds: The large overall score counts rapidly upward and lands precisely on 92. The level settles on 46. Each attribute bar fills smoothly from left to right in sequence—Speed 93, Power 91, Control 88, Stamina 90, Agility 94, Technique 89—each landing with a restrained mint pulse. The radar chart draws outward from its center and locks into the exact final polygon. Skill cards activate from top to bottom; their icons flare briefly while the ACTIVE and ULTIMATE states illuminate.
10.8–13.3 seconds: The player ID strip and bottom navigation fade and slide into their exact final positions. The wind energy around Kaze accelerates clockwise, wrapping around the rotating ball and sweeping behind her body with layered luminous trails. Kaze tightens her hand, leans slightly into the current, and gives one natural blink; preserve her identity, anatomy, costume, and right-side placement.

13.3–15 seconds: The energy arc reaches a bright controlled crest, then settles into a living idle pulse. Hold the fully assembled screen matching @[ref img] exactly. Kaze continues subtle breathing; hair and ribbons drift, the football rotates slowly, particles shimmer, and all stats remain stable and readable.

Use crisp premium game-UI motion, clean 2D anime character animation, subtle depth between Kaze and the interface, and stable legible typography. Keep every panel, icon, label, number, and geometric boundary fixed once revealed. Do not introduce new text, extra characters, additional objects, logos, captions, or UI elements.

Audio: low electronic boot hum, delicate scanning ticks, short confirmation tones as values lock, rising airy wind around the ball, soft cloth movement, and one refined completion chime. No dialogue and no music.

prompts.prompt:
15秒古装电影写实剧情，花海庭园氛围，镜头丝滑自然推进，情绪反转强烈，人物表演细腻真实，有明显的“悠闲惬意 -> 突闻噩耗 -> 身体先崩 -> 情绪失控前的不可置信”递进。女人一开始站在花丛中悠闲赏景，手中轻轻摇着团扇，神情放松，眼神柔和，肩膀、手腕和呼吸都是松弛的，衣袖、发饰和流苏在微风里轻轻晃动，整个人毫无防备。画外突然传来带着慌乱和哭腔的女声：“夫人！老爷被斩首了！”

0-3秒：镜头穿过前景花丛丝滑推近到女人半身，女人悠闲地轻轻扇着团扇，神情安静惬意，嘴角甚至有一丝若有若无的闲适笑意，正在轻松看风景。

3-6秒：画外音猛地刺入：“夫人！老爷被斩首了！”女人的扇风动作瞬间断掉，手腕僵在半空，眼神猛地定住，呼吸像被一下掐断，头极轻地偏过去一点，像不敢相信自己听到了什么，脸上的放松感瞬间消失。

6-10秒：她猛地往后退一步，肩膀本能一缩，后背绷紧，脚下发软，差点站不稳跌倒，另一只手下意识抬起想抓住什么稳住自己却落空。与此同时，拿扇子的手因惊吓脱力，团扇从指间滑落，掉进脚边花丛里。她眼睛失神般睁大，嘴唇微张，想说话却几乎发不出声，只能失神低语：“你……说什么？”

10-15秒：镜头迅速压近到脸和上半身。她勉强站住，但整个人像魂被抽空，胸口呼吸乱掉，眼眶迅速泛红，泪意猛地涌上来。她不是立刻大哭，而是先陷入更狠的不可置信崩塌状态，表情从空白到震惊再到痛得不敢承认，嘴唇发抖，眼神溃散，像下一秒就要彻底撑不住。

音效与配乐：前半段是柔和古风环境音与轻微风声、衣袖与花叶摩擦声；噩耗传来的一瞬间配乐骤停半拍，再压入低沉悲音和压迫弦乐；团扇掉进花丛要有清晰轻响；整体情绪要像中国古装电影中的突变悲剧时刻。

负面限制：不要夸张嚎哭，不要立刻瘫倒，不要卡通化表演，不要慢动作，不要过多甩头动作，不要让团扇乱飞太远，不要字幕。

prompts.prompt:
Create a 15 second, 16:9 luxury fashion commercial using @Image1@Image2 as exact visual references. @Image1 is the sole product reference. Preserve the bag’s exact proportions, pale grey white woven textile, irregular rectangular stitching, soft structure, curved flap, silver clasp, four black eyelets, side construction, zipper details, and hardware. Do not reinterpret it as leather. The bag has two separate short straps made from silver chain woven with matching textile. Preserve their exact construction, attachment points, resting positions, and maximum lengths. The front strap connects only the two front eyelets. The rear strap connects only the two rear eyelets. They must never cross, merge, disappear, duplicate, lengthen, or be rerouted. @Image2 is the exact character reference. Preserve the woman’s face, green eyes, straight blonde bob, natural proportions, and understated makeup. Dress her consistently in a sophisticated beige silk summer mini dress with a square neckline, narrow shoulder straps, fitted waist, and softly moving skirt. Add ivory slingback heels and small pearl earrings. The bag is the visual anchor throughout. It must always be the largest, brightest, sharpest, or most prominently framed element. The woman, hotel, landscape, and car are supporting elements only.
0 to 1.75 seconds: Tight product shot of the bag alone on a sunlit limestone console beside a softly shimmering Riviera pool. Directional sunlight reveals the textile weave, stitching, two straps, four eyelets, side details, and clasp. 1.75 to 3.25 seconds: Keep the bag large and tack sharp in the foreground while the woman approaches through the bright hotel suite in soft focus. She has not touched it yet. 3.25 to 5 seconds: Extreme close up of her fingers lifting both straps together. Keep the front and rear straps visibly separate, correctly routed, and uncrossed. Show realistic chain tension, textile threaded through the links, and accurate hands. 5 to 7 seconds: She places both short straps together over one shoulder and wears the bag as a side shoulder bag. It hangs close beneath her arm, high against the side of her upper waist. It must never reach her hip or thigh. Both straps remain visibly separate, uncrossed, and at their true maximum length. 7 to 9 seconds: Close tracking shot through a sunlit hotel colonnade, composed mainly around the bag moving naturally against the beige silk dress. The straps respond realistically to her steps, shoulder movement, tension, and gravity. 9 to 11 seconds: The bag stands upright and tack sharp on a pale stone terrace table. Its two straps settle naturally and remain identifiable. The woman sits behind it in soft focus, looking toward the sea. 11 to 13 seconds: She carries the bag on one shoulder toward a cream vintage convertible. In a tight product focused montage, she opens the driver door, removes both straps from her shoulder, and carefully places the bag upright on the front passenger seat cushion. The bag’s entire base must rest directly on the horizontal cushion where a passenger sits. It is not on the backrest, headrest, seat edge, center console, or top of the seat. The passenger backrest rises behind it. Both straps settle naturally beside and partly behind the bag without disappearing. She enters the driver seat. Keep the car cropped and secondary. 13 to 15 seconds: The car moves along the Riviera coast. Keep the bag upright, large, and tack sharp on the passenger seat cushion while the woman holds steering wheel and drives in the soft background. The sea and road pass through the windows in gentle motion blur. Moving sunlight reveals the woven textile, stitching, eyelets, two distinct straps, and hardware. End with one controlled flash across the silver clasp.
Use bright, fashion forward European luxury cinematography inspired by a restored 1990s campaign film. Directional Mediterranean sunlight, dimensional shadows, layered reflections, warm 35 mm grain, gentle haliation, creamy highlights, subtle film weave, natural motion blur, and tactile textile detail. Use elegant editorial cuts, realistic movement, accurate hands, and consistent spatial logic. Add a sophisticated original fashion score with crisp percussion, warm bass, airy electronic textures, subtle chain sounds, clasp click, silk movement, footsteps, coastal ambience, car door movement, and quiet engine sound. No dialogue. No product redesign, leather texture, colour change, altered stitching, missing or merged straps, crossed straps, extra straps, extended straps, changed eyelet routing, crossbody carry, low hip placement, warped chains, changed hardware, duplicated bag, distorted hands, outfit changes, blue dress, car hero shot, wide vehicle profile, empty road shot, incorrect seat placement, text, or subtitles.

prompts.prompt:
Style: Adult animated television comedy in the distinctive flat-vector / limited-animation style of a suave-spy cartoon. Bold inked outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, slightly stiff comedic timing, hard graphic shadows, subtle film-grain texture. 2K, cinematic but comedic.

Setting: A bright sunny beach. Clear blue sky, soft sand, ocean waves in the background.

Characters:
Sterling Archer: a handsome secret agent with jet-black slicked-back hair, wearing a tight dark swimsuit. Self-satisfied, manic energy, perpetually smug.
Lana Kane: a tall, striking brown-skinned female agent, wearing a stylish bikini. Exasperated, eyes-wide "are-you-kidding-me" energy.

Shot 1 (0:00–0:03): Medium shot of Archer and Lana standing on the beach. Archer cups his hands around his mouth and calls out: <d>[English] Lana? Lana? LANA!!!!</d>

Shot 2 (0:03–0:05): Cut to Lana turning sharply toward him, annoyed: <d>[English] What?!</d>

Shot 3 (0:05–0:07): Archer leans in with a smug grin: <d>[English] With MiniMax any internet pervert can draw us!</d>

Shot 4 (0:07–0:08): Lana frowns, confused: <d>[English] What do you mean?</d>

Shot 5 (0:08–0:09): Archer points at her with a knowing look: <d>[English] They can even change your clothes!</d>

Shot 6 (0:09–0:10): Quick flash. Lana’s bikini instantly becomes a modern one-piece swimsuit. She looks down in surprise.

Shot 7 (0:10–0:11): Another quick flash. The swimsuit changes into a 1920s-style bathing suit. Lana’s eyes widen further.

Shot 8 (0:11–0:13): Final flash. The bathing suit disappears completely. Lana is suddenly naked and quickly covers herself with both hands, shocked and angry: <d>[English] Archer, stop that!</d>

Shot 9 (0:13–0:15): Archer raises both hands defensively, looking genuine: <d>[English] That’s not me!</d>

overall_soundscape: Soft ocean waves and light beach ambience. Clear comedic dialogue with sharp cuts between the clothing changes.

non_diegetic_music: None. Dry, absurd, self-aware comedic timing.

提示词灵感来源于 douyin 的【小彻的AI乱造】（国内的朋友可以关注下，真的把minimax 玩出花了）

游戏宣传 PV，整体为纯二维中式剪纸版画动画与黑色电影平面合成。【美术风格】红黑视觉风格：深墨黑、朱砂红、暗猩红、骨白和少量旧金色构成高反差画面，人物使用硬边剪影、木刻纹理与套印错位效果，阴影只有一至两层。城市被高度平面化，只保留中式牌楼、红柱、木窗格、灯笼、屋檐、电线、潮湿石板路和高楼剪影，以粗糙木刻线条、剪纸层次、飞白墨痕与大面积负空间构成。融合旧式通缉海报、犯罪漫画封面、皮影戏、印章、雨线、纸屑和水墨笔触。画面像一张张被撕开、压印、重新拼贴的红黑犯罪海报，空间允许不合理地折叠、拉长、平移和错位。转场依靠人物剪影、短刀刀痕、纸张撕裂、红色印章、墨迹擦除和黑白反相完成。红色只用于灯笼、反派服饰、酒液、危险信号、印章与关键情绪爆点。
【角色】女主为参考图中的黑发年轻女性，穿黑色长衣与长靴，手持一把短刀。保留她冷冽、克制、强势的气质；人物造型简洁平面，主要由黑色身体剪影、骨白色面部与刀刃高光、暗红色轮廓线组成。反派为提供参考图中的女性：黑色长发盘起，佩戴红色耳坠，身穿深红色华贵长袍，长袍有繁复的金色龙纹刺绣。她气质端庄、从容、优雅而危险，始终带着淡淡的审视感与掌控感；人物以深红剪纸轮廓、旧金色木刻纹样和黑色阴影表现，不要写实肖像，不要改变其红袍与金色刺绣的核心识别特征。
【分镜】0–3 秒纯黑背景中落下斜向朱砂红雨线，女主的黑色长靴与短刀刀尖出现，只有人物下半身，没有完整街景。脚步落下时，骨白色木刻裂纹、红色印章残影和不规则纸片从地面向外弹开。短刀刀尖划过画面，留下一道骨白色的刀痕，切开黑暗。
3–6 秒镜头沿短刀向上移动，女主身体由黑色剪影、骨白面部和暗红衣摆分层揭示。她从一张黑色通缉海报上的剪影瞬间翻转为木刻版画人物，再恢复为红黑剪纸动画形象。背景城市不是立体场景，而是由中式屋檐、窗棂、灯笼、电线和高楼轮廓逐层压印拼合。
6–9 秒女主继续向前行走，人物保持侧面平移，背景像展开的长卷画一样向反方向滑动。巨大的暗红色印章圆形从她身后压下，黑色屋檐和骨白雨线穿过人物，将画面切成多个不规则纸片区域。女主冰冷的眼睛短暂出现在独立的横向木刻特写框中。
9–12 秒一只骨白色纸剪蝴蝶掠过女主眼前，蝴蝶轮廓放大成为覆盖画面的红黑纸屑。女主握住短刀，刀刃横向扫过，但不进入写实战斗；刀光直接转化为白色书法笔锋、破碎的红色月亮和飞散的印刷颗粒。反派以红袍女性的皮影剪影出现：金色龙纹像木刻图案沿衣袖和披肩亮起，她站在红月中央，面容只显露一双冷静的眼睛与微微上扬的嘴角。
12–15 秒进入快速红黑版画蒙太奇：女主侧脸、握刀手部、短刀轮廓、反派红袍上的金色龙纹、反派耳坠、红色满月、灯笼和雨夜屋檐不断重叠。人物动作以关键姿态、剪纸抽拉和海报定格表现，不制作连续写实打斗。每次鼓点触发黑白反相、单帧朱砂红闪和纸张撕裂。最后女主站在纯黑城市剪影中央，短刀垂在身侧；反派的红袍剪影在她身后如幕布般展开，猩红月亮收缩成一滴酒液，酒液扩散为原创游戏标题，出现英文文案：“BLADE IN THE RAIN”。
【严格限制】全片保持二维剪纸、木刻版画、皮影与红黑犯罪海报美术不要抽象科技 MG，不要写实光影，不要立体 3D 城市，不要电影级真实透视，不要复杂连续打斗，不要大面积霓虹灯，不要赛博朋克写实街景。人物、建筑、房间和道具全部平面化、剪影化、纸张化、图形化，所有镜头都像一张动态的红黑犯罪版画海报。

prompts.prompt:
[REFERENCE CONTROL]

Use the uploaded PART 2 storyboard image for “The Tiny Florist and the Sleeping Mountain Giant” as the PRIMARY visual, character, environment, scale, prop, color, performance, and narrative reference.

This sequence continues DIRECTLY from PART 1.

PART 1 ended with:
- Brum still peacefully asleep beneath the ancient tree
- exactly ONE small flower already tucked into his enormous beard
- Mimi discovering that her woven flower basket is still completely full
- Mimi getting an excited “bigger makeover” idea
- Buzz realizing exactly where this is going and saying “NO.”

Generate a FINISHED cinematic animation from this storyboard.

DO NOT reproduce the storyboard sheet itself.

The final video must NOT contain:
- storyboard borders
- panel numbers
- timestamps
- handwritten captions
- dialogue bubbles
- storyboard headers
- production notes
- character reference drawings
- scale charts
- paper texture
- footer decorations

The uploaded storyboard locks:

1. Mimi’s exact identity and costume
2. Buzz’s exact design and goggles
3. Brum’s exact giant face, beard, vest and proportions
4. extreme tiny-vs-giant scale
5. existing single flower from Part 1
6. progressive flower-beard makeover
7. pink petal approaching Brum’s nose
8. giant harmless sneeze
9. Mimi safely holding one beard strand
10. Brum waking gently
11. Mimi’s tiny “Surprise?” reaction
12. Brum lifting Mimi safely onto his palm
13. pond reflection reveal
14. Brum loving the makeover
15. final Buzz “NO.” joke
16. squirrel relaxing inside the finished beard
17. final magical forest hero shot

Translate the 15 storyboard panels into approximately 9 fluid cinematic shots.

DO NOT create fifteen rapid one-second cuts.

Prioritize:
clear cause → action → consequence → reaction → emotional payoff.

--------------------------------------------------

[VIDEO GOAL]

Duration:
EXACTLY 15 seconds

Story time:
0:15–0:30

Aspect Ratio:
16:9 landscape

Frame-rate feeling:
cinematic 24 fps

Visual medium:
premium painterly 2D animated short film

Genre:
whimsical fantasy comedy + heartwarming friendship

Audience:
family-friendly

Dialogue:
natural synchronized English

Audio:
native dialogue + SFX + forest ambience + original music

EMOTIONAL ARC:

creative obsession
→ escalating makeover comedy
→ proud reveal
→ suspicious nose twitch
→ tiny petal suspense
→ enormous harmless sneeze
→ awkward “caught” moment
→ giant discovers makeover
→ unexpected emotional appreciation
→ joyful friendship
→ final comedy button

The finished 30-second story should feel COMPLETE at the end.

--------------------------------------------------

[PART 2 CORE STORY]

Mimi decides one flower is not enough.

She decorates Brum’s beard with:
- daisies
- pink blossoms
- little yellow flowers
- small vines
- tiny mushrooms
- one tiny sunflower

The enormous messy beard becomes a whimsical miniature beard garden.

Mimi proudly admires her masterpiece.

Buzz notices Brum’s nose twitching.

A loose pink petal drifts toward Brum’s nostril.

The petal tickles his nose.

Brum inhales.

Mimi and Buzz realize what is about to happen.

Brum sneezes.

The huge but harmless sneeze sends petals swirling through the air.

Mimi grabs one enormous beard strand safely.

Buzz tumbles comedically.

Brum wakes.

Mimi nervously says:

<d>[English] Surprise?</d>

Instead of getting angry, Brum discovers his decorated beard.

He sees himself reflected in a nearby pond.

He loves it.

He tells Mimi no one has decorated his beard in a hundred years.

Then Brum asks Buzz if he helped.

Buzz instantly replies:

<d>[English] NO.</d>

End with Brum, Mimi, Buzz and the squirrel happily together.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — MIMI]

Match PART 1 and the uploaded PART 2 storyboard EXACTLY.

MIMI:

Tiny young florist approximately the height of Brum’s thumb.

Appearance:
- warm light skin
- large expressive brown eyes
- soft rounded face
- fluffy chestnut-brown short bob
- natural loose strands
- same small childlike proportions

Clothing:
- mint-green dress / work outfit
- sunflower-yellow florist apron
- small red-brown gardening boots
- tiny florist/tool pouch
- woven flower basket

Personality:
- fearless
- artistic
- cheerful
- mischievously confident
- caring
- extremely proud of her work

PART 2 PERFORMANCE ARC:

0–4 sec:
inspired creative frenzy

4–6 sec:
extremely proud

6–9 sec:
confusion → realization → panic

9–11 sec:
startled but safe

11–13 sec:
nervous vulnerability

13–15 sec:
surprise → relief → joy

CRITICAL:

Keep exact:
- face
- chestnut bob
- outfit
- apron
- boots
- proportions
- tiny scale

Mimi must remain thumb-sized throughout.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — BRUM]

Match PART 1 EXACTLY.

BRUM:

Enormous gentle forest giant.

Appearance:
- warm tan skin
- massive round face
- enormous broad nose
- thick brown eyebrows
- huge textured chestnut/dark-brown beard
- moss-green vest
- large wooden buttons
- mossy patches
- enormous gentle hands

Personality:
- peaceful
- sleepy
- warm
- kind
- teddy-bear gentle
- slightly goofy

PART 2 PERFORMANCE ARC:

sleeping peacefully
→ subtle nose twitch
→ sneeze buildup
→ enormous harmless sneeze
→ groggy awakening
→ confusion
→ curiosity
→ wonder
→ heartfelt delight

IMPORTANT:

Brum must NEVER:
- become angry
- threaten Mimi
- shout aggressively
- grab Mimi
- look evil

The first opened-eye reveal may feel enormous because of scale, but Brum himself is simply sleepy and confused.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — BUZZ]

Same Buzz from PART 1.

Appearance:
- tiny round golden-yellow bee
- dark stripes
- large expressive eyes
- tiny goggles
- translucent wings
- small antennae

Scale:
approximately the size of Mimi’s head.

Personality:
- cautious
- dryly sarcastic
- responsible
- loyal
- perpetually expecting Mimi’s plans to go wrong

PART 2 PERFORMANCE ARC:

horrified by flower overload
→ exhausted assistant
→ notices danger first
→ full sneeze panic
→ tumbles safely
→ hides
→ relief
→ denies responsibility

The FINAL “NO.” is Buzz’s biggest comedy beat.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — SQUIRREL]

Same tiny squirrel from PART 1.

Appearance:
- warm brown fur
- fluffy tail
- large dark eyes
- acorn

The squirrel is completely comfortable living inside Brum’s beard.

It should appear only subtly during the makeover or final shot.

Final:
squirrel sits happily among flowers inside the beard, eating its acorn.

--------------------------------------------------

[BEARD GARDEN CONTINUITY]

At the first frame:

Brum’s beard still has EXACTLY the single flower from Part 1.

Build progressively.

STAGE 1:
single existing flower

STAGE 2:
Mimi adds several daisies and pink blossoms

STAGE 3:
small vines and additional flowers

STAGE 4:
tiny mushrooms + small sunflower

STAGE 5:
finished beard garden

Finished appearance:
- brown beard remains dominant and visible
- flowers woven naturally between curls
- white daisies
- pink blossoms
- little yellow flowers
- small lavender flowers
- green vines
- tiny red-and-white mushrooms
- one small sunflower
- bits of moss

Do NOT cover Brum’s entire beard with flowers.

It must still clearly be a beard.

--------------------------------------------------

[FLOWER PHYSICS]

Flowers are real lightweight flowers.

They should:
- bend softly
- move with Brum’s breathing
- react naturally to breeze
- shed only a few petals during sneeze

No glowing magical flowers.

No instant plant growth.

Mimi physically decorates the beard.

--------------------------------------------------

[KEY SNEEZE PETAL LOCK]

Use ONE clearly readable soft pink petal.

The suspense sequence must clearly show:

finished beard
→ Brum’s nose twitches
→ pink petal loosens
→ petal floats upward
→ petal approaches nostril
→ touches / tickles nose
→ Brum inhales
→ SNEEZE.

Do not make the sneeze happen randomly.

The viewer must understand the cause.

--------------------------------------------------

[SNEEZE SAFETY RULE]

The sneeze is the largest comedy action of the film, but it is completely harmless.

The gust may cause:
- flower petals to swirl
- loose leaves to fly
- Mimi’s hair to blow backward
- Mimi’s apron to flutter
- Buzz to spin through petals
- butterflies to scatter
- light flowers to shake

Mimi grabs one thick beard strand before being moved far.

She NEVER falls.

Buzz NEVER crashes painfully.

Brum’s beard remains intact.

No trees break.

No objects become dangerous projectiles.

No injuries.

No destruction.

--------------------------------------------------

[ENVIRONMENT LOCK]

Use the same enchanted forest clearing as Part 1.

Maintain:
- giant ancient tree
- thick roots
- golden sunlight
- ferns
- wildflowers
- mushrooms
- stones
- leafy canopy
- atmospheric forest depth
- warm moss
- nearby reflective pond
- drifting petals
- Brum’s same resting position

The pond should already exist spatially nearby so Brum can see his reflection naturally after waking.

Do not teleport characters to another location.

--------------------------------------------------

[SCALE RULES]

Scale is CRITICAL.

Mimi = approximately Brum’s thumb height.

Buzz = Mimi-head-sized.

Squirrel = slightly larger than Mimi.

Brum = colossal.

Visual examples:
- Mimi fits comfortably in Brum’s palm
- Brum’s eye is larger than Mimi
- Brum’s nose towers above Mimi
- one beard strand is thick enough for Mimi to grip with both hands

Maintain scale even during close-ups.

--------------------------------------------------

integrated_multimodal_description:

[SHOT 1] — 0.00s–2.20s
ONE FLOWER BECOMES A WHOLE PLAN

Continue directly from Part 1.

Mimi stands inside Brum’s enormous beard beside the ONE flower she already placed.

She looks toward her overflowing basket.

Buzz hovers beside her.

Buzz:
<d>[English] Mimi... no.</d>

Mimi gives him an innocent smile.

Mimi:
<d>[English] Just a few more.</d>

Immediately begin a fluid makeover montage.

Mimi grabs several daisies and pink blossoms.

She moves quickly but carefully across huge beard curls.

She tucks:
one flower,
then another,
then another.

Buzz follows with increasing disbelief.

Dialogue:

Buzz:
<d>[English] That is already more than “a few.”</d>

Mimi:
<d>[English] Art cannot be counted, Buzz.</d>

Camera:
close-up of single flower
→ pan toward full basket
→ Mimi inspired expression
→ tracking across beard as decorations begin.

Sound:
- basket wicker
- soft petals
- beard fibers
- Buzz wings
- Brum snoring underneath everything

Music:
fast light pizzicato makeover rhythm.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 2] — 2.20s–4.20s
THE BEARD MAKEOVER ESCALATES

Continue in one energetic montage.

Mimi:
- loops a soft green vine around one beard curl
- tucks white daisies into another
- places a tiny mushroom between curls
- adjusts several pink blossoms
- carefully sets one small sunflower into the upper beard

Buzz carries a tiny flower stem reluctantly.

He looks exhausted.

A squirrel briefly peeks from the beard, watches them, takes one calm bite from its acorn, then disappears back inside.

Mimi finishes one last adjustment.

Dialogue:

Mimi:
<d>[English] Daisy... vine... mushroom...</d>

She raises the tiny sunflower.

Mimi:
<d>[English] And... masterpiece!</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] We have different definitions of “small makeover.”</d>

Camera:
macro flower placement
→ beard-level lateral tracking
→ squirrel reaction
→ pull outward.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 3] — 4.20s–5.70s
THE BEAUTIFUL BEARD GARDEN

Wide reveal.

Brum remains completely asleep beneath the giant tree.

His massive brown beard is now transformed into a whimsical miniature flower garden.

Keep the brown beard highly visible beneath:
- flowers
- vines
- mushrooms
- tiny sunflower

A few butterflies naturally approach.

Mimi stands proudly on Brum’s chest / lower beard area with hands on hips.

Buzz hovers beside her, exhausted.

Mimi:
<d>[English] Perfect.</d>

Buzz looks upward.

His eyes suddenly widen.

Buzz:
<d>[English] Mimi...</d>

Camera:
beautiful wide reveal
→ slow push toward Buzz’s worried face.

Music:
makeover melody resolves beautifully, then suddenly thins.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 4] — 5.70s–7.30s
THE NOSE TWITCH

Extreme scale close-up.

Brum’s enormous nose fills much of the frame.

TWITCH.

Mimi looks upward.

Buzz points urgently.

Brum’s nose twitches again.

TWITCH.

One soft pink flower petal loosens from the decorated beard.

It slowly rises on Brum’s breathing airflow.

Mimi watches it.

Buzz watches it.

Camera alternates focus:

nose
→ floating petal
→ Mimi
→ Buzz
→ nostril.

Dialogue:

Mimi, whispering:
<d>[English] What?</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] Petal.</d>

Mimi:
<d>[English] Where?</d>

Buzz points.

Mimi sees it.

Mimi:
<d>[English] Oh no.</d>

Sound:
- nose twitch
- subtle air inhale
- tiny petal flutter
- Buzz wings stop briefly

Music:
playful suspense plucks.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 5] — 7.30s–8.60s
“AAAAAH...”

The pink petal floats directly toward Brum’s nostril.

Time feels slightly slower for comedy.

The petal gently touches the edge of his nose.

Brum’s eyebrows squeeze.

Nostrils flare slightly.

His chest begins a giant inhale.

<d>[English] Aaaaaah...</d>

Mimi freezes.

Buzz’s eyes become enormous.

Mimi quickly grabs one thick beard strand with both arms.

Buzz grabs onto a flower stem or hovers ready.

Mimi:
<d>[English] Hold on!</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] I KNEW IT!</d>

Camera:
macro petal contact
→ Brum pre-sneeze face
→ tiny Mimi/Buzz reaction at beard scale
→ wider shot showing huge size difference.

Sound:
massive but comedic inhale.

Music:
ascending comedic tension.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 6] — 8.60s–9.70s
THE GIANT SNEEZE

BRUM:

<d>[English] ACHOOOO!</d>

A huge harmless gust bursts outward.

Show a spectacular painterly swirl of:
- pink petals
- daisies
- light leaves
- flower pollen sparkles
- butterflies

Mimi safely grips one thick beard hair.

Her body stretches nearly horizontal from wind for a brief comedic beat.

Her apron and hair flutter wildly.

Buzz spins harmlessly through flower petals.

His goggles stay attached.

The squirrel ducks comfortably deeper into Brum’s beard while still holding its acorn.

Only a few loose flowers fly away.

Most of the beard garden remains beautifully intact.

Camera:
medium-wide side angle showing gust
→ brief dynamic follow of swirling petals
→ return toward Mimi gripping beard.

Sound:
huge warm cartoon sneeze
- gust of air
- petals
- Mimi tiny surprised yell
- Buzz spinning buzz

Music:
large playful orchestral/comedy accent.

NO violent impact.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 7] — 9.70s–11.20s
AND NOW THE GIANT IS AWAKE

The sneeze ends.

Everything becomes suddenly quiet.

Petals drift slowly downward.

Mimi hangs safely from one thick beard strand.

Her basket hangs from one arm.

Buzz hides behind the tiny sunflower.

Brum’s giant eyelid slowly opens.

His enormous eye focuses.

He looks downward.

Mimi looks up.

The giant eye fills most of her world.

Pause.

No scary music.

Mimi slowly lifts one tiny hand.

Mimi:
<d>[English] ...Surprise?</d>

Buzz peeks from behind flower.

Brum blinks.

Camera:
Mimi hanging
→ enormous eye opening
→ extreme scale two-shot
→ hold on awkward silence.

Sound:
- one last petal falling
- forest suddenly audible again
- soft eye blink
- Buzz nervous wing buzz

Music:
one tiny comedic pluck, then silence.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 8] — 11.20s–13.20s
BRUM DISCOVERS HIS MAKEOVER

Brum does NOT get angry.

His expression is sleepy and confused.

He carefully places one enormous open palm below Mimi.

Mimi lets go of the beard and lands safely standing in the center of his palm.

Buzz lands beside her.

Brum uses his other hand to gently touch the flowers in his beard.

He notices:
daisies,
vine,
mushrooms,
sunflower.

Brum:
<d>[English] Flowers?</d>

Mimi nervously nods.

Mimi:
<d>[English] I thought your beard needed... a little help.</d>

Brum raises one eyebrow.

He glances toward the nearby pond.

Camera follows his gaze.

Show Brum’s reflection in the still water.

For the first time he sees:
his enormous warm face
+
magnificent flower-covered beard.

His confusion becomes surprise.

Then the biggest gentle smile.

Dialogue:

Brum, softly:
<d>[English] Oh...</d>

Sound:
- soft beard rustle
- pond water
- warm forest ambience

Music:
heartwarming melody begins.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 9] — 13.20s–15.00s
THE BIGGEST DAY BRIGHTENED

Brum holds Mimi and Buzz safely on his open palm near his face.

His eyes are warm.

Brum:
<d>[English] No one has decorated my beard in a hundred years.</d>

Mimi’s nervous expression melts into a proud smile.

Brum:
<d>[English] I love it.</d>

Mimi:
<d>[English] Really?</d>

Brum nods.

Very quick fluid transition into the FINAL hero composition:

Brum now walks happily through the sunlit forest.

His flower beard is bright and beautiful.

Mimi sits proudly on his shoulder.

Buzz flies beside them.

The squirrel sits comfortably inside the beard eating its acorn.

Butterflies gently follow the flowers.

Brum glances toward Buzz.

Brum:
<d>[English] Did you help?</d>

Buzz immediately shakes his entire body.

Buzz:
<d>[English] NO.</d>

Mimi bursts into a tiny laugh.

Brum chuckles warmly.

Camera:
medium emotional palm shot
→ seamless pull/transition to final walking wide
→ slow final pull-back through flowers and golden forest light.

Hold final composition briefly.

FADE TO BLACK.

END.

--------------------------------------------------

[AUDIO DESCRIPTION]

Generate synchronized native stereo audio.

--------------------------------------------------

[MIMI VOICE]

Natural tiny young girl voice.

Qualities:
- bright
- playful
- confident
- warm
- artistic
- expressive
- clear English
- slightly mischievous

Performance progression:

0–5 sec:
creative excitement.

5–8 sec:
concerned whisper.

8–10 sec:
comedic panic.

10–12 sec:
tiny nervous vulnerability.

12–15 sec:
relief and joy.

Important line:

<d>[English] ...Surprise?</d>

Deliver this very softly and awkwardly.

It should be one of the funniest moments.

--------------------------------------------------

[BUZZ VOICE]

Small expressive bee voice.

Qualities:
- slightly high
- fast
- skeptical
- anxious
- dry comedic timing
- subtle buzzing quality

Important moments:

<d>[English] Petal.</d>

<d>[English] I KNEW IT!</d>

Final:

<d>[English] NO.</d>

The final “NO.” must be immediate, loud relative to Buzz’s tiny voice, and perfectly timed for comedy.

--------------------------------------------------

[BRUM VOICE]

Large, deep but extremely gentle giant voice.

Qualities:
- warm bass
- sleepy
- slow
- kind
- comforting
- slightly rustic
- no threatening resonance

His huge body size gives his voice depth, but the delivery remains soft.

Dialogue:

<d>[English] Flowers?</d>

<d>[English] No one has decorated my beard in a hundred years.</d>

<d>[English] I love it.</d>

<d>[English] Did you help?</d>

No shouting except the involuntary sneeze.

--------------------------------------------------

[SQUIRREL AUDIO]

Minimal:
- tiny acorn crunch
- little squeak
- soft beard rustle

--------------------------------------------------

[FOREST ENVIRONMENT AUDIO]

Use:
- birds
- light breeze
- leaves
- insects
- butterflies subtle wing flutter
- Brum breathing
- distant woodland atmosphere
- pond ambience near reflection
- soft footfalls during final walking shot

Keep environment warm and peaceful.

--------------------------------------------------

[SOUND DESIGN — MAKEOVER]

Use satisfying miniature sounds:

flower placement:
soft “tup”

vine movement:
light leaf rustle

mushroom placement:
soft tiny “pop”

basket:
wicker movement

Buzz:
wing vibration

beard:
soft dense hair fibers

Keep all sounds delicate relative to Brum’s scale.

--------------------------------------------------

[SOUND DESIGN — SNEEZE]

Sneeze buildup:

nose twitch
→ subtle sniff
→ longer inhale
→ tension silence
→ “ACHOOOO!”

The sneeze should have:
- deep low-frequency body
- warm cartoon quality
- broad gust
- fluttering petals

Do NOT use:
- explosive boom
- shockwave
- destructive impact
- frightening sound design

After sneeze:
immediate contrast into near silence.

This silence makes Brum opening his eye funnier.

--------------------------------------------------

[NON-DIEGETIC MUSIC]

Use an ORIGINAL whimsical fantasy-animation score.

Instrumentation:
- pizzicato strings
- flute
- clarinet
- bassoon
- marimba
- glockenspiel
- light harp
- warm strings
- subtle acoustic plucks

MUSIC ARC:

0.00–2.20
fast mischievous makeover rhythm.

2.20–4.20
creative montage acceleration.

4.20–5.70
warm “masterpiece” flourish.

5.70–7.30
music strips down to tiny suspense plucks.

7.30–8.60
ascending comedic pre-sneeze tension.

8.60–9.70
big playful sneeze accent.

9.70–11.20
near silence / tiny comedy note.

11.20–13.20
soft emotional warmth.

13.20–15.00
joyful friendship resolution.

Final Buzz “NO.” can receive one tiny comic musical punctuation.

No epic trailer music.

No scary music.

--------------------------------------------------

[CAMERA LANGUAGE]

Use cinematic storybook camera work.

CAMERA ARC:

0–4 sec:
energetic miniature makeover coverage.

4–6 sec:
beautiful wide reveal.

6–8.6 sec:
increasingly tight suspense coverage.

8.6–9.7 sec:
largest dynamic movement during sneeze.

9.7–11.2 sec:
sudden stillness + extreme scale.

11.2–13.2 sec:
warm character-focused coverage.

13.2–15 sec:
open into a beautiful final wide shot.

Preferred techniques:
- macro close-ups
- beard-level tracking
- gentle dolly
- rack focus
- extreme scale compositions
- slow-motion-feeling petal approach
- controlled dynamic sneeze shot
- pond reflection shot
- final slow pull-back

Avoid:
- shaky handheld camera
- extreme Dutch angles
- action-movie spinning
- excessive zooming
- disorienting cuts

--------------------------------------------------

[VISUAL STYLE]

Premium finished painterly 2D animated short.

MATCH PART 1 EXACTLY.

Use:
- hand-drawn ink contours
- watercolor/gouache painted fills
- warm storybook textures
- rich but soft forest backgrounds
- expressive facial animation
- appealing rounded character forms
- highly detailed beard texture
- gentle atmospheric depth
- natural flower movement
- cinematic golden lighting
- subtle squash and stretch

The finished video should look like the uploaded illustrations have come alive.

NOT:
- storyboard animatic
- motion comic
- slideshow
- photorealism
- 3D CGI
- vector animation
- anime
- cel-shaded 3D

--------------------------------------------------

[COLOR / LIGHTING]

0–5.7 sec:

warm greens + browns with rapidly increasing flower color:
- pink
- yellow
- white
- lavender
- mint
- sunflower gold

5.7–8.6 sec:

keep environment warm but isolate the pink petal visually against Brum’s brown beard/nose.

8.6–9.7 sec:

petal swirl becomes brightest colorful action moment.

Use:
- pink petals
- yellow flowers
- pale lavender
- leaf green
- warm sunlight

9.7–13.2 sec:

return to softer natural forest palette.

13.2–15 sec:

richest warm golden light.

Brum’s beard flowers glow naturally in the sunlight.

Final frame:
warm gold,
moss green,
brown,
colorful floral accents.

No artificial neon glow.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — MIMI]

Use:
- tiny quick decorating movements
- balancing across beard curls
- reaching into basket
- natural flower placement
- proud hands-on-hips pose
- sudden freeze when nose twitches
- firm but safe beard grip during sneeze
- natural nervous wave after Brum wakes
- relaxed seated shoulder pose at final

During sneeze:
Mimi may stretch with wind, but her hands stay securely on the beard strand.

No uncontrolled flight.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — BRUM]

Until sneeze:
- slow breathing
- small nose twitches only

Pre-sneeze:
- chest expands
- eyebrows tighten
- nostrils flare
- head moves only slightly

Sneeze:
one clear forward motion.

After:
- settles
- eyes slowly open
- gentle blinking
- controlled careful hand movements

When lifting Mimi:
Brum places palm beneath her and lets her step/drop only a tiny safe distance.

No pinching.

No grabbing.

--------------------------------------------------

prompts.prompt:
[REFERENCE CONTROL]

Use the uploaded PART 1 storyboard image for “The Tiny Florist and the Sleeping Mountain Giant” as the PRIMARY visual, character, environment, scale, prop, performance, color, and narrative reference.

Generate a FINISHED animated sequence from the storyboard.

Do NOT reproduce the storyboard sheet itself.

The final video must NOT contain:
- storyboard borders
- storyboard panels
- panel numbers
- timestamps
- handwritten captions
- production notes
- character reference drawings
- scale reference diagrams
- storyboard paper texture
- footer decorations
- title/header text

The uploaded storyboard locks:

1. Mimi’s exact visual identity
2. Brum’s exact giant design
3. Buzz’s exact bee design
4. squirrel design
5. extreme tiny-vs-giant scale
6. Brum’s enormous tangled beard
7. Brum’s moss-green vest and giant buttons
8. Mimi’s flower basket
9. Mimi’s tiny turquoise comb
10. twigs, leaves, moss and tiny nest inside beard
11. same magical forest clearing
12. enormous ancient tree
13. warm golden forest lighting
14. painterly storybook 2D animation style
15. Part 1 story progression
16. final basket-of-flowers cliffhanger

Animate the storyboard as one seamless cinematic short.

Do NOT animate all 15 storyboard panels as fifteen one-second hard cuts.

Combine the visual beats into approximately 8 coherent shots with natural cause → action → reaction storytelling.

--------------------------------------------------

[VIDEO GOAL]

Duration:
exactly 15 seconds

Story time:
0:00–0:15

Aspect ratio:
16:9 landscape

Frame-rate feeling:
cinematic 24 fps

Genre:
whimsical fantasy comedy

Visual medium:
premium painterly 2D animated short film

Audience:
family-friendly

Dialogue language:
English

Audio:
native synchronized dialogue + character sounds + environment + SFX + music

EMOTIONAL ARC:

magical calm
→ enormous sleepy reveal
→ scale comedy
→ Mimi notices a problem
→ secret mission
→ delicate grooming
→ surprise beard resident
→ silent teamwork
→ first flower success
→ dangerous BIG IDEA cliffhanger

Part 1 should feel cute, clever and increasingly mischievous.

--------------------------------------------------

[PART 1 STORY LIMIT]

PART 1 ONLY.

START:

Brum is peacefully asleep beneath the enormous ancient tree.

END:

Mimi has placed ONLY ONE flower in Brum’s beard.

She notices her still-full basket of flowers.

Her face lights up with a much bigger decorating idea.

Buzz realizes what she is thinking.

CUT TO BLACK.

DO NOT show:
- multiple flowers being added
- finished beard garden
- vines wrapped through beard
- mushrooms added to beard
- tiny sunflower decoration
- butterflies gathering around decorated beard
- Brum’s nose twitch
- floating petal near his nose
- giant sneeze
- Brum waking
- Mimi hanging from beard hair
- pond reflection
- emotional approval
- Brum walking through forest

Those belong to PART 2.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — MIMI]

Match the uploaded storyboard exactly.

MIMI is extremely tiny — approximately the height of one of Brum’s thumbs.

Appearance:
- tiny young florist
- warm light skin
- large expressive brown eyes
- soft rounded face
- fluffy chestnut-brown bob haircut
- tousled short hair
- natural loose strands around her face

Clothing:
- mint-green dress / work outfit
- sunflower-yellow florist apron
- tiny red-brown gardening boots
- miniature florist pouch
- woven flower basket
- same clothing colors and proportions throughout

Personality:
- fearless
- playful
- artistic
- curious
- highly confident
- caring
- easily inspired

PART 1 PERFORMANCE ARC:

0–3 sec:
happy forest traveler → startled by giant snore

3–5 sec:
concerned professional florist studying Brum’s beard

5–9 sec:
determined tiny adventurer

9–12 sec:
confident groomer → startled by squirrel

12–15 sec:
delighted by first flower → dangerous creative inspiration

Mimi must never look genuinely frightened of Brum.

She knows he is sleeping and believes she can improve his beard.

CRITICAL IDENTITY:

Maintain exact:
- face
- chestnut bob
- clothing
- yellow apron
- green outfit
- boots
- scale
- basket

No costume drift.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — BRUM]

Match the storyboard exactly.

BRUM:

an enormous gentle mountain/forest giant.

Appearance:
- warm tan skin
- enormous rounded face
- giant broad nose
- thick dark-brown eyebrows
- huge fluffy chestnut/dark-brown beard
- very long tangled beard curls
- mossy green vest
- giant circular wooden buttons
- slight moss / natural forest textures
- enormous hands
- peaceful closed eyes

Scale:

Brum must feel truly enormous.

Mimi:
approximately thumb-height.

One vest button:
close to Mimi’s torso height.

One thick beard curl:
large enough for Mimi to stand beside and climb around.

Brum’s face:
many times larger than Mimi’s entire body.

Personality:
- gentle
- peaceful
- deep sleeper
- warm teddy-bear energy

During PART 1 Brum NEVER fully wakes.

Allowed sleeping reactions:
- breathing
- enormous snore
- small smile
- eyebrow twitch
- subtle beard movement from breath

Do NOT open Brum’s eyes.

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — BUZZ]

Match storyboard exactly.

BUZZ:

tiny round golden bee approximately the size of Mimi’s head.

Appearance:
- golden-yellow fuzzy round body
- darker bee stripes
- large expressive eyes
- tiny blue-gray goggles
- small translucent wings
- little antennae
- miniature tool carrier / tiny blue florist bucket when visible

Personality:
- responsible
- cautious
- loyal
- anxious
- highly expressive
- comedy warning character

PART 1 PERFORMANCE:

happy companion
→ blown by snore
→ concerned about Mimi’s plan
→ nervous during climb
→ watches Brum carefully
→ shocked by squirrel
→ increasingly alarmed by flower idea

Buzz should mostly communicate through:
- wing buzzes
- tiny gasps
- squeaks
- short dialogue

--------------------------------------------------

[CHARACTER IDENTITY LOCK — SQUIRREL]

Match the storyboard.

A tiny warm-brown woodland squirrel.

Features:
- soft warm-brown fur
- lighter belly
- large dark eyes
- fluffy curled tail
- holding one acorn
- comfortable living inside Brum’s beard

Personality:
- surprisingly calm
- protective of sleeping Brum
- treats the beard like home

The squirrel appears ONLY after Mimi removes a twig.

Its reveal should be surprising but adorable.

--------------------------------------------------

[BRUM'S BEARD — ENVIRONMENT LOCK]

Brum’s beard is not merely facial hair.

From Mimi’s scale, it behaves like a miniature landscape.

Use:
- enormous twisted beard curls
- soft brown hair ridges
- tunnels between curls
- tangled twigs
- green leaves
- small moss patches
- tiny nest
- hidden squirrel space

The beard must still clearly look like natural hair.

Do not turn it into literal soil or forest ground.

Hair physics:
soft,
thick,
springy,
heavy relative to Mimi.

When Mimi brushes:
individual curls gently straighten and settle.

--------------------------------------------------

[KEY PROP LOCK — MIMI'S COMB]

Tiny turquoise/mint hand comb.

Small enough for Mimi.

Used to groom Brum’s beard carefully.

Do not change it into a full-sized human comb.

--------------------------------------------------

[KEY PROP LOCK — FLOWER BASKET]

Mimi’s woven florist basket.

Contains many colorful fresh flowers:
- pink
- purple
- yellow
- white
- small daisies
- little wildflowers
- leafy stems

At the beginning:
basket remains mostly full.

At the end:
only ONE flower has been removed.

The basket must still look obviously full.

This visual is essential to the cliffhanger.

--------------------------------------------------

[ENVIRONMENT LOCK — MAGICAL FOREST]

Maintain the exact storybook forest atmosphere from the uploaded storyboard.

Setting:
- enormous ancient tree
- thick trunk
- sprawling roots
- mossy forest floor
- ferns
- mushrooms
- wildflowers
- scattered leaves
- stones
- soft grassy patches
- distant forest depth
- warm golden sunlight filtering through canopy
- tiny drifting petals / leaves
- atmospheric dust motes

Brum sleeps at the base of the same tree.

Do not relocate him.

Lighting direction must remain coherent throughout.

--------------------------------------------------

[SCALE RULES]

Extreme scale contrast is one of the main visual hooks.

Always preserve:

Mimi = thumb-sized.

Buzz = approximately Mimi-head-sized.

Squirrel = comparable to / slightly larger than Mimi.

Brum = gigantic.

Important visual scale examples:

Mimi climbs one vest button like a stair.

Mimi walks through beard curls like thick tree roots.

One beard hair bundle is large enough for Mimi to hold.

Brum’s nose is enormous relative to Mimi.

Never accidentally render Mimi adult-human-sized next to Brum.

--------------------------------------------------

[WORLD / PHYSICS RULES]

All actions follow understandable physical cause and effect.

Brum snores
→ air pushes leaves and petals
→ Mimi and Buzz wobble backward.

Mimi sees messy beard
→ decides to fix it.

Mimi climbs giant vest
→ reaches beard.

Mimi combs beard
→ twig becomes loose.

Mimi pulls twig
→ squirrel hidden behind it appears.

Squirrel warns them
→ everyone becomes quiet.

Squirrel leaves
→ Mimi notices flower.

Mimi places ONE flower
→ beard looks unexpectedly beautiful.

Mimi sees full basket
→ inspiration escalates.

No unexplained magic.

The forest may feel magical, but no supernatural transformations occur in Part 1.

--------------------------------------------------

integrated_multimodal_description:

[SHOT 1] — 0.00s–1.80s
THE SLEEPING MOUNTAIN

Open with a beautiful cinematic wide shot of the enchanted forest clearing.

Golden sunlight streams through the huge tree canopy.

Tiny particles float in the light.

Wildflowers sway.

Camera slowly glides around one massive tree root.

Reveal BRUM asleep against the enormous ancient trunk.

His giant green-vested body occupies a large portion of the clearing.

His enormous brown beard spills across his chest like a tangled hillside.

Brum inhales.

Then—

<d>[English] SNORRRR...</d>

A harmless breath wave travels through nearby flowers.

Petals and leaves flutter outward.

Camera:
wide forest establishing shot
→ slow reveal of Brum
→ gentle push toward sleeping face.

Sound:
- forest birds
- leaves
- distant insects
- low peaceful giant breathing
- deep comedic snore
- flowers fluttering

Music:
soft magical flute + pizzicato + warm strings.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 2] — 1.80s–3.30s
THE TINY FLORIST MEETS THE SNORE

Cut much lower to Mimi’s scale.

Mimi walks into the clearing carrying her flower basket.

Buzz hovers beside her.

Another giant snore arrives.

A visible but soft gust pushes:
- Mimi’s short hair backward
- her yellow apron outward
- Buzz several centimeters sideways
- loose petals past camera

Mimi plants her tiny boots and leans forward against the breeze.

Buzz spins once and rights himself.

Mimi looks upward.

Her eyes grow huge when she finally understands the “hill” is a sleeping giant.

Dialogue:

Mimi:
<d>[English] Whoa...</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] Very big napper.</d>

Mimi smiles rather than panics.

Camera:
low character-level medium shot
→ tilt upward along Brum’s enormous body
→ emphasize extreme scale.

Sound:
- snore gust
- cloth flutter
- Buzz wing buzz
- falling leaves

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 3] — 3.30s–5.00s
THE REAL PROBLEM

Mimi studies Brum.

Her attention moves from his peaceful sleeping face...

down into the enormous tangled beard.

Camera follows her gaze.

Reveal close beard details:

- tangled curls
- twig
- several leaves
- moss
- tiny nest tucked deep inside
- messy knots

Mimi puts one tiny hand to her chin like a professional stylist inspecting a client.

Her expression changes:

surprise
→ concern
→ determination.

Dialogue:

Mimi:
<d>[English] Buzz...</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] Yes?</d>

Mimi points dramatically toward beard.

<d>[English] That beard needs help.</d>

Buzz stares at the enormous beard.

Then at sleeping Brum.

Buzz:
<d>[English] Of course it does.</d>

Camera:
Mimi close-up
→ POV into beard landscape
→ macro details
→ two-shot Mimi/Buzz.

Music:
small mischievous plucked motif begins.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 4] — 5.00s–6.80s
THE SECRET BEARD MISSION

Mimi tightens her florist pouch and starts climbing Brum’s moss-green vest.

She uses Brum’s gigantic wooden vest buttons like climbing steps.

Show scale clearly:

one button is nearly as large as Mimi’s torso.

Mimi climbs:
button
→ fold in vest
→ next button.

Buzz follows hovering close behind with her tiny supplies.

Brum continues breathing deeply.

His huge chest rises gently beneath them.

Mimi pauses for one breath as the “ground” rises.

Then continues.

Dialogue:

Mimi, whispering:
<d>[English] Quiet feet.</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] You are climbing a giant.</d>

Mimi:
<d>[English] Very quiet feet.</d>

Camera:
side wide scale shot
→ low view upward along giant vest
→ close-up Mimi pulling herself onto final button
→ reveal beard looming above.

Sound:
- tiny boot taps
- fabric creak
- Buzz wing hum
- Brum breathing
- small button tap

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 5] — 6.80s–9.20s
THE BEARD LANDSCAPE

Mimi and Buzz reach Brum’s beard.

From their scale, enormous brown curls surround them like thick twisting vines.

Mimi steps carefully onto a broad curl.

She removes her tiny turquoise comb.

She begins gently combing one small section.

SCRITCH...
SCRITCH...

A leaf comes loose.

Then another.

One beard curl slowly becomes neat and smooth.

Brum’s sleeping mouth forms the tiniest peaceful smile.

Mimi notices.

Her confidence grows.

Dialogue:

Mimi, whispering:
<d>[English] See? He likes it.</d>

Buzz watches Brum nervously.

Buzz:
<d>[English] He is unconscious.</d>

Mimi:
<d>[English] Still counts.</d>

Camera:
wide beard-landscape reveal
→ close-up tiny comb moving through giant hair
→ leaf falling
→ cut to Brum’s sleepy smile
→ Mimi proud reaction.

Sound:
- soft comb through hair
- hair fibers
- leaves falling
- Brum sleepy exhale
- Buzz wing flutter

Music:
gentle playful grooming rhythm.

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 6] — 9.20s–11.40s
THE SECRET RESIDENT

Mimi notices one stubborn twig lodged between beard curls.

She sets down the comb.

Grabs the twig with both tiny hands.

She pulls.

Once.

Nothing.

She braces one boot against a beard curl.

Pulls again.

The twig pops free.

Behind it—

two tiny eyes appear.

Mimi freezes.

Buzz freezes.

A warm-brown SQUIRREL suddenly pops out holding an acorn.

All three stare at each other.

One quiet beat.

Mimi:
<d>[English] Oh!</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] Oh no.</d>

The squirrel puts one finger/paw near its mouth.

“Shhh.”

Then points upward toward sleeping Brum.

Mimi instantly understands.

She slowly puts a finger over her own lips.

Dialogue, whispered:

Mimi:
<d>[English] We won’t wake him.</d>

The squirrel gives a serious nod.

Camera:
close-up twig
→ tiny pull
→ reveal squirrel
→ reaction close-ups
→ wider four-layer scale composition with sleeping Brum behind.

Sound:
- twig creak
- tiny “pop”
- soft squirrel squeak
- music briefly stops for reveal
- Brum continuing to snore quietly

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 7] — 11.40s–13.30s
ONE LITTLE FLOWER

The squirrel quietly slips deeper through the beard and exits toward another curl, still carrying its acorn.

Mimi watches it go.

Then she notices a single small purple-pink wildflower caught/growing near the beard edge.

Her eyes brighten.

Buzz immediately recognizes the expression.

Buzz:
<d>[English] Mimi...</d>

Mimi gently plucks/picks up the loose flower.

Dialogue:

Mimi:
<d>[English] Just one.</d>

Buzz narrows his eyes skeptically.

Mimi carefully tucks the flower between two neat beard curls.

She adjusts it once.

Steps backward.

The tiny flower looks surprisingly beautiful against Brum’s huge brown beard.

A tiny warm sparkle of sunlight catches its petals — natural light, not magical transformation.

Mimi beams.

Dialogue:

Mimi:
<d>[English] Perfect.</d>

Camera:
flower insert
→ Mimi’s idea expression
→ gentle placement
→ close beauty shot of single flower
→ Mimi/Buzz reaction.

Sound:
- tiny petal rustle
- beard fibers
- soft musical “ting”

--------------------------------------------------

[SHOT 8] — 13.30s–15.00s
THE MUCH BIGGER IDEA — CLIFFHANGER

Mimi admires the ONE flower.

Then slowly turns.

Camera follows her eyes toward her woven basket.

The basket is overflowing with:

- pink flowers
- purple flowers
- white daisies
- yellow blossoms
- leafy stems

Mimi’s eyes widen.

Her mouth slowly curls into an enormous creative grin.

A metaphorical tiny “idea” sparkle may appear in her eye, but no literal floating lightbulb is necessary.

Buzz looks at Mimi.

Then the flower.

Then the enormous basket.

Then Brum’s gigantic beard.

Buzz’s expression becomes pure dread.

Buzz:
<d>[English] Mimi... no.</d>

Mimi slowly reaches toward the basket.

Mimi, delighted whisper:
<d>[English] Maybe... a few more?</d>

Buzz:
<d>[English] NO.</d>

Brum snores peacefully in the background.

The single flower gently trembles from his breath.

Camera:
close Mimi
→ POV basket
→ slow push into Mimi’s inspired grin
→ Buzz reaction
→ final wide shot showing tiny Mimi + full basket + enormous beard + sleeping Brum.

CUT TO BLACK.

END PART 1.

Do NOT begin decorating with additional flowers.

--------------------------------------------------

[AUDIO DESCRIPTION]

Generate synchronized native stereo audio.

--------------------------------------------------

[MIMI VOICE]

Natural young girl voice.

Qualities:
- bright
- confident
- warm
- creative
- playful
- slightly mischievous
- clear English
- not overly babyish

Her delivery should often become a whisper because Brum is asleep.

Performance progression:

0–3 sec:
surprised curiosity

3–6 sec:
professional determination

6–11 sec:
focused whisper-comedy

11–13 sec:
gentle excitement

13–15 sec:
dangerous creative enthusiasm

--------------------------------------------------

[BUZZ VOICE]

Tiny expressive bee voice.

Qualities:
- slightly higher pitch
- quick
- cautious
- dry comic timing
- understandable English
- small buzzing undertone without harming intelligibility

Buzz should sound like the sensible friend who already knows where this is going.

Final:

<d>[English] NO.</d>

should land as the comedy button.

--------------------------------------------------

[BRUM AUDIO]

Brum does NOT have normal dialogue in Part 1.

Use only:
- deep breathing
- relaxed snoring
- small satisfied sleepy exhale
- perhaps a gentle sleepy hum while Mimi combs him

Snoring should sound huge but cozy.

Not monstrous.

--------------------------------------------------

[SQUIRREL AUDIO]

No full dialogue required.

Use:
- tiny squeak
- quiet “shh” gesture sound
- acorn movement
- soft rustling

--------------------------------------------------

[FOREST ENVIRONMENT AUDIO]

Maintain:
- gentle birds
- distant woodpecker/insects if subtle
- leaves rustling
- warm breeze
- tiny petals falling
- grass
- mushrooms/forest floor movement
- occasional distant woodland ambience

Use strong scale contrast in audio:

Brum’s breathing = huge low soft layer.

Mimi/Buzz = tiny close-detail sounds.

--------------------------------------------------

[SOUND EFFECT PRIORITIES]

Important synchronized effects:

Brum snore:
deep warm “SNORRRR”

snore gust:
soft rush of air

Mimi climbing:
tiny fabric/boot sounds

Buzz:
wing buzz changes with emotion

comb:
delicate “scritch-scritch”

twig:
tiny creak then pop

squirrel reveal:
soft rustle + squeak

flower placement:
small petal rustle

basket:
light wicker movement

--------------------------------------------------

[NON-DIEGETIC MUSIC]

Create an ORIGINAL whimsical fantasy-comedy score.

Instrumentation:
- pizzicato strings
- soft flute
- bassoon / clarinet for giant comedy
- light marimba
- glockenspiel
- subtle acoustic plucks
- warm strings
- tiny bell accents

MUSIC ARC:

0.00–1.80
magical forest wonder.

1.80–3.30
gentle giant-scale comedy.

3.30–5.00
curious “problem discovered” motif.

5.00–6.80
light sneaking rhythm.

6.80–9.20
playful grooming rhythm.

9.20–11.40
tiny suspense → cute reveal.

11.40–13.30
warm charming flower motif.

13.30–15.00
mischievous “big idea” buildup ending with a short comedic sting after Buzz says “NO.”

No epic score.
No danger music.
No horror.
No dramatic action trailer music.

--------------------------------------------------

[CAMERA LANGUAGE]

The visual hook depends heavily on scale.

CAMERA PROGRESSION:

0–3 sec:
majestic forest wides + tiny character scale reveal.

3–6 sec:
problem-focused medium and close coverage.

6–9 sec:
miniature adventure perspective.

9–12 sec:
intimate beard-level comedy.

12–15 sec:
reaction-driven creative cliffhanger.

Preferred camera techniques:
- slow cinematic dolly
- environmental reveal
- tilt from Mimi to giant
- macro beard details
- shallow parallax through beard curls
- over-the-shoulder views
- low miniature POV
- expressive reaction close-ups
- slow final push-in

AVOID:
- handheld shaking
- crash zooms
- hyperfast cutting
- Dutch angles
- 360-degree spins
- action-film camera behavior

--------------------------------------------------

[VISUAL STYLE]

Premium finished painterly 2D animation.

Match the storyboard artwork closely:

- delicate ink-like outlines
- rich hand-painted backgrounds
- watercolor/gouache-style color texture
- warm illustrated storybook aesthetic
- cinematic dappled lighting
- expressive faces
- slightly rounded character designs
- beautifully textured beard
- lush forest foliage
- clear silhouette staging
- subtle squash and stretch
- detailed but readable environment

The finished video should feel like the storyboard illustrations have come alive.

NOT:
- storyboard animation
- motion comic
- photorealistic film
- 3D CGI
- vector animation
- anime
- cel-shaded 3D
- slideshow

--------------------------------------------------

[COLOR / LIGHTING]

Primary palette:
- forest green
- moss green
- warm brown
- chestnut
- golden yellow
- mint
- muted turquoise
- flower pink
- lavender
- cream

Lighting:
warm late-morning / magical golden forest sunlight.

Use:
- leaf-shaped shadows
- warm rim light
- subtle volumetric rays
- soft highlights on Brum’s beard
- warm bounce on Mimi’s face
- light catches on Buzz’s wings

The single flower at the end may receive a tiny natural golden highlight.

No artificial magical glow explosion.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — MIMI]

Mimi moves like a tiny energetic person in an enormous environment.

Use:
- small quick steps
- careful climbing
- expressive hands
- hair bounce
- apron flutter
- natural effort pulling twig
- gentle combing
- subtle balance shifts on beard curls

Do not:
- make her weightless
- make her fly
- use superhero jumps

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — BRUM]

Brum remains mostly asleep and heavy.

Use:
- slow chest rise/fall
- beard slightly moving with breath
- nostrils subtly moving during snores
- tiny sleepy smile during grooming
- fingers completely relaxed

No major body movement.

No waking.

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — BUZZ]

Use:
- natural bee hovering
- rapid wings
- small inertia when changing direction
- blown sideways by snore
- hovering at Mimi’s shoulder height
- exaggerated eyebrow/eye reactions

--------------------------------------------------

[MOTION RULES — BEARD]

The beard must feel soft and dimensional.

Use:
- slight compression beneath Mimi
- springy curl response
- comb separating hair
- gentle settling after brushing
- individual loose hairs reacting to Brum’s breath

Do not make beard behave like rigid branches.

--------------------------------------------------

[CONTINUITY RULES]

Keep exactly:
- one Mimi
- one Buzz
- one Brum
- one squirrel
- same ancient tree
- same forest clearing
- same beard shape
- same vest
- same buttons
- same basket
- same comb
- same outfit
- same scale

Mimi begins on the forest floor.

She climbs Brum before reaching beard.

Do not teleport her.

The squirrel appears only after the twig is removed.

After squirrel exits, do not duplicate it elsewhere.

Only ONE flower is placed in Part 1.

At final frame:
basket remains full.

Brum’s eyes remain closed.

prompts.prompt:
5秒，4:3，顶级东方仙侠3A游戏CG，电影级高端宣传片，严格参考图1的月下仙城场景与美术气质：巨大明月、云海天宫、环形仙城、悬浮仙山、瀑布、白玉仙桥、金顶楼阁、冷蓝月光。整体画面必须唯美、恢弘、神圣、危险、酷炫，像大厂正式游戏开场CG，不像普通AI视频。

双主角设定：男剑仙，黑色长发，白蓝战袍，冰蓝雷光长剑，英俊冷峻，强大沉稳；女剑仙，黑色长发，白青仙裙，月白灵剑与月华法术，清冷绝美，高贵飘逸。反派为黑金重甲魔修，手持黑色巨剑，周身暗红黑色魔气，压迫感极强。人物脸和服装全程稳定统一，保持高级游戏角色建模质感。

开场镜头从巨大明月前高速穿越云海与浮空仙山，俯冲进入宏伟仙城，来到白玉高台，男女主背对镜头立于高台边缘，衣袍长发飞扬，英雄感极强。远处天空突然裂开暗红色空间裂缝，魔修高速坠落，轰然落地，引发碎石、冲击波和魔气爆发。

男剑仙瞬间拔剑冲出，与魔修在仙桥中央高速对撞，剑刃碰撞爆发蓝红双色能量冲击、空间波纹、火星与剑气。近战动作凌厉、清晰、有重量感，包含高速斩击、格挡、反击、短暂慢动作碰撞特写，镜头低机位跟拍与高速环绕，极具电影感。

随后女剑仙御剑升空，展开巨大蓝白仙阵，发动“万剑齐发”，数百柄发光飞剑如流星暴雨般射向魔修，夜空被剑光点亮。魔修爆发黑红魔气，凝聚巨大的魔龙反击，空中连续爆炸。男剑仙御剑穿梭爆炸火光与云海，一剑斩裂魔龙，空战场面华丽震撼。

最后魔修释放百米高的黑红魔神法相，遮蔽天空。男女主并肩悬空，男剑仙开启覆盖半个天空的金蓝剑阵，女剑仙召唤巨大的白蓝月华莲华法相，二人联手凝聚数百米长的金蓝神剑，与魔神巨剑正面碰撞。碰撞瞬间进入超级慢动作，蓝色雷电、金色符文、白色月华、红色魔焰与空间裂痕同时凝固，随后爆发毁天灭地的大爆炸，形成巨大的环形云洞与能量冲击波。

结尾爆炸光芒散去，巨大明月重现，男女主并肩立于悬空巨剑之上俯瞰整座仙城，周围灵剑环绕，远处天宫亮起金蓝光柱，镜头缓慢拉远，形成极强的高级游戏主视觉结尾，并预留后期添加Logo空间。

镜头要求：超广角航拍、俯冲推进、低机位英雄视角、高速跟拍、环绕镜头、御剑追踪、短暂升格慢动作、终极碰撞震动、史诗级拉远收尾。镜头必须流畅稳定，不乱晃，不跳轴。

视觉要求：特效炫丽但高级干净，不能廉价光污染。强调冰蓝雷电剑气、金色仙纹、月华粒子、飞剑阵、空间裂缝、黑红魔焰、魔龙、巨大法相、神剑、冲击波、体积云、瀑布水雾、发光碎片。人物主体始终清晰，画面精致通透，PBR材质，真实布料与长发动效，电影级光影与空间层次。

音效：原生立体声。包含高空风声、远处钟鸣、低沉鼓点、剑刃碰撞、破风声、雷电炸裂、万剑掠空、魔龙低吼、终极爆炸低频冲击。无对白，无字幕，无水印，无乱码。

prompts.prompt:
😊🌹👇

1960年代，香港邵氏復古電影風格：戴黑粗框眼鏡、頭髮微捲及肩的霸總生氣地按住女秘書(粉紅色廉價套裝、明顯腮紅、淡藍色眼影)的肩膀，質問女秘書道"昨晚，妳到底去了哪裡？"。女秘書開始眼眶泛淚，推開霸總的雙手，然後轉身拭淚哭泣著說"總裁這是我私人的事情，不用你管!"。總裁快步接近女秘書，然後將女秘書的身體按壓在復古的竹製躺椅上，總裁認真地對女秘書說"對不起，我錯了。"然後總裁開始親吻女秘書的臉頰。女秘書一邊假裝喘氣，一邊從總裁的背後拿高了手機喀擦一聲拍照。下一個畫面是香港街道的路人，手中拿著報紙(上面有總裁親吻流淚女秘書的自拍照 新聞標題寫著"OFFICE SCANDAL")。下一個畫面是圍著時尚花頭巾的女秘書(改穿米色連身風衣、黑色高跟鞋)自信地"哼"一聲，從書報攤拿了一份有相同頭版照片的報紙，然後得意地看著鏡頭比了個"shh"的手勢。畫面fade into black.

#AIDrama #AIFillm #AIMovie #AIVideo #microdrama #CEO #霸道總裁
